findings.evidence: grep: `def occCount {N : ℕ} (w : Fin N → α) (a : α) : ℕ := Nat.card {i : Fin N // w i = a}` (TransitionCount.lean:77); `theorem occCount_eq_card_filter ... occCount w a = #{i : Fin N | w i = a}` (line 86); `theorem sum_occCount_eq_card ... ∑ a ∈ S, occCount w a = N` (line 243), itself proved via `Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise`. `fiberCount` on `X = Fin N` is definitionally the same count.
findings.fix: Keep one construction: define the general `Fintype X` count in `TauCeti/Data/Fintype/Fiber.lean` and make the `Fin N` word statistic in TransitionCount.lean that construction (delete `occCount` in favour of it, or define the word lemmas `occCount_eq_card_filter`/`sum_occCount_eq_card` as instances of the shared lemmas), updating the uses in TransitionCount.lean and Combinatorics/Enumerative/LastExit.lean:390-392. findings.issue: `fiberCount obs σ` duplicates the existing `TauCeti.occCount` (TauCeti/Combinatorics/Enumerative/TransitionCount.lean:77, `Nat.card {i : Fin N // w i = a}`), generalized from `Fin N` to a `Fintype` index. The lemma sets are near-clones: `fiberCount_eq_card_filter` vs `occCount_eq_card_filter` (TransitionCount.lean:86), `sum_fiberCount` vs `sum_occCount_eq_card` (TransitionCount.lean:243). Two parallel counting APIs now coexist.

findings.fix: Replace the body with: `classical; have h := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to' (s := Finset.univ) (t := Finset.univ.image columns) (g := obs) (fun x _ => by obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := cover x; exact Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨c, Finset.mem_univ _, hc⟩) weight; rw [Finset.sum_image hinj.injOn] at h; simpa only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_comm, fiberCount] using h`. Likewise `sum_fiberCount` is `Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)` (Basic.lean:993), which is how `sum_occCount_eq_card` already proves it.
findings.issue: `sum_mul_fiberCount` re-derives Mathlib's fiberwise-sum lemma by a manual `sum_comm`/`sum_eq_single` argument. `Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to'` (Mathlib/Algebra/BigOperators/Group/Finset/Basic.lean:272) plus `Finset.sum_image` (line 95, to_additive) and `Finset.sum_const` give it directly; `Finset.sum_comp` (line 706, to_additive) is the same identity in the `columns = id` form.

summary: The polynomial/moment layer (signSum, tarskiQuery, signCount, fullMatrix, fullInverse and their identities) is new: Mathlib has only Sturm sequences (Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Sturm/Sequence.lean), binary kroneckerMap, and no Tarski query. But TauCeti.Data.Fintype.Fiber introduces a second fiber-counting API parallel to the existing TauCeti.occCount, and its main lemma re-derives Mathlib's fiberwise-sum lemmas.
